verdicts.reason: A: the quote is squeezed into tiny two-line text in the centre while the yellow attribution 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' sits bottom-left at about the same weight, so it competes with the message and is read before it. The Solstice logo is gone, and the glass is cropped into a cramped sliver at the right edge. B: the quote is larger and reads well as the clear focal point, but the attribution is dropped and the logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck stranded in a dead middle gap. The glass is tiny, so the right half feels empty and unbalanced.
